text: no there is one for instantmesh also, i know because we setup one and i didnt like it so we setup another and it was instant mesh thats why its in the deps
resolution: User believed a single-verb InstantMesh command already existed (they recall setting up two image->3D backends, disliking the first). Investigated exhaustively: grepped tools/, scripts/, cli/, genmesh.py, git history (all branches), untracked files, shell rc aliases, and bash history. Finding: there is NO pre-existing InstantMesh verb. What exists is (1) genprop, whose backend is locked to shap-e only -- the disliked one; and (2) deps/InstantMesh/ (conda env + weights, still untracked) usable ONLY via the upstream run.py smoke-test line from setup-instantmesh.sh -- which is the manual command the user remembers, never a wrapper. The setup script's final line confirms 'genmodel --backend instantmesh' was planned but never wired. Conclusion relayed to user: my new tools/instantmesh (req_1574) is not a duplicate but the missing verb; offered to instead wire InstantMesh into genprop as --backend instantmesh. Awaiting user direction.
